summary: A five-day Taipei trip based beside Ximen Station. It covers the National Palace Museum, a Beitou hot spring soak, a Jiufen and Yehliu day trip, and the Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall, Din Tai Fung and a sunset climb up Elephant Mountain. Some named stops, including Shilin Night Market, Shifen and Tamsui, couldn't be confirmed and aren't scheduled. The 13:55 flight home also leaves only a short final morning.
